title: IE Executive
description:
**Job Title: I**
E Executive

**Industry:**
Garment / Apparel Manufacturing

**Department:**
Industrial Engineering

**Experience:**
2–3 Years

**Work Location:**
Tirupur, Tamil Nadu

**Job Purpose**

To support the Brand Industrial Engineering function through SMV calculation, Line layout planning and analysis, Method improvement, and Video study with a strong focus on productivity, efficiency improvement, and continuous SMV reduction.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. SMV & Method Study**

* Develop, analyse, and maintain accurate SMVs for garment products.
* Strong understanding of SMV calculation, Operation Breakdown, Work Measurement, and Sewing Methods.
* Identify and implement improved sewing methods to reduce operation time and improve productivity.
* Continuously identify opportunities for SMV reduction through better methods, Machine attachments, and Work aids.
* Study best sewing methods in vendor factories and support implementation across other factories.
* Knowledge of SMV/IE software will be an added advantage.

**2. Line Layout Planning & Analysis**

* Prepare production line layouts based on SMV, operation breakdown, manpower, machine requirements, and achievable production targets.
* Review and improve layouts based on actual production performance.
* Visit vendor factories to verify implementation of approved line layouts.
* Check actual manpower allocation, machine positioning, operation sequence, and production flow against the approved layout.
* Monitor target achievement, line efficiency, productivity, and bottlenecks.
* Identify gaps between planned and actual performance and follow up with factory teams for corrective action.

**3. Video Study**

* Regularly visit vendor factories to conduct video/motion studies for products and operations.
* Analyse operator movements, operation methods, handling, and unnecessary motions.
* Identify the most efficient sewing methods and use findings to support SMV validation and reduction.
* Maintain records of improved methods and share best practices across factories.

**Key Requirements**

* 2–3 years' relevant experience in Garment Industrial Engineering.
* Strong practical knowledge of SMV, Line layout planning, method study, line balancing, and productivity improvement.
* Good understanding of garment sewing operations and manufacturing processes.
* Experience in conducting video/motion studies is preferred.
* Knowledge of SMV/IE software is an added advantage.
* Strong analytical, observation, communication, and follow-up skills.
* Must be willing to travel regularly to vendor factories.
